spans.s:
लश् {c10c} U. (लाशयति-ते) To
exercise or practise any art; cf. लस्.

लष् {vI.v} {c1c} {c4c} P. (लषति-ते, लष्यति-ते)
(लषित) To wish, desire, long for, be
eager for; (usually with the
preposition अभि q. v.). {vII.v} {c10c} U. (
लाषयति-ते) = लश् q. v.

लस् I. {c1c} P. (लसति, लसित)
1 To
shine, glitter, flash; मुक्तहरेण
लसता हसतीव स्तनद्वयं K.

.
--2 To
appear, arise, come to light.
--3 To
embrace.
--4 To play, frolic about,
skip about, dance.
--5 To sound,
resound. --Caus. (लासयति-ते)
1 To
cause to shine, grace, adorn.
--2 To
cause to dance.
--3 To exercise an art.

लसित p. p. [लस्-क्त] Played,
sported, appeared, manifested, skipping
about &c.; see लस्.

1 Saliva.
--2 Pus, matter.
--3 The juice of the sugar-cane.
--4
Lymph.

1 A female dancer.
--2 A
harlot, wanton or unchaste woman.
--3 A kind of dramatic performance.

लस्त a.
1 Embraced, clasped.
--2
Skilful, skilled.

लस्ज् {c1c} A. (लज्जते, लज्जित)
1 To
be ashamed, feel shame (oft. with
instr. or inf.); स्त्रीजनं प्रहरन्कथं न
लज्जसे

.
--2 To
blush. --Caus. (लज्जयति-ते) To put
to shame;

लस्तकः The middle of a bow,
that part which is grasped.

लाषुक a. (का or की f.)
Covetous, greedy, avaricious.

लासः [लस्-घञ्]
1 Jumping,
sporting, skipping about, dancing;
मदनजनितलासैः

.
--2
Dalliance, wanton sport.
--3 Dancing as
practised by women.
--4 Soup, broth.

लासक a. (सिका f.) [लस्-ण्वुल्]
1 Playing, frolicking, sporting.
--2
Moving hither and thither.
--कः
1 A dancer.
--2 A peacock.
--3
Embracing.
--4 N. of Śiva.
--कं A room
on the top of a building, turret.

लास्यं [लस्-ण्यत्]
1 Dancing; a
dance; आस्ये धास्यति कस्य लास्यमधुना…
वाचां विपाको मम

.
--2 A dance accompanied with singing
and instrumental music.
--3 A dance
in which the emotions of love
are represented by means of
various gesticulations and attitudes.
--स्यः A dancer, an actor.
--स्या A
dancing girl.
